name: cloudflare-ops
description: Connect a Cloudflare account in two minutes, then manage DNS, subdomains, Pages and R2 from the agent. Three checkboxes instead of 392 permissions, and the token is never typed into the chat.
author: Itqan Lab

name: dokploy-ops
description: Connect one or more self-hosted Dokploy installations, then run what is deployed on them from the agent — deploy and watch the build to the end, read logs, restart, check domains and health. Adopts a key the machine already has, and keeps several installations apart by name.
author: Itqan Lab

name: hetzner-ops
description: Connect one or more Hetzner Cloud projects, then run the servers from the agent — create, resize, reboot, delete, SSH keys, firewalls, DNS and running costs. Adopts a token the machine already has, and keeps several projects apart by name.
author: Itqan Lab

name: namecheap-ops
description: Connect one or more Namecheap accounts, then run the domains from the agent — expiry and auto-renew, nameservers, availability, prices and DNS records. Handles Namecheap's address whitelist, including through an SSH server with a fixed address. Adopts a key the machine already has, and keeps several accounts apart by name.
author: Itqan Lab

name: plane-fleet
description: Run a Plane board with a team of agent roles: a PM that claims tickets and lands approved PRs, parallel engineers each in its own worktree and environment slot, blind testers that check every PR in the browser and add tests, and a ticket writer. Roles can also run on other coding CLIs, picked per spawn by task kind and remaining budget.
author: Itqan Lab

name: audio-narrate
description: Turn text into natural English or Arabic narration for free: one file, or one file per scene for a video. Online neural voices by default, an offline engine when there is no internet, and a pronunciation list for words the voice gets wrong. No key and no account.
author: Itqan Lab

name: audio-transcribe
description: Turn speech in any audio or video into text, on this machine, free. Arabic and English, local files and links, plain text or subtitles. Whisper runs locally: no API key, nothing leaves the machine.
author: Itqan Lab

name: elevenlabs-studio
description: Voice-over, sound effects, music, transcription, voice changing, noise removal and dubbing with ElevenLabs, from the agent, spending the credits on purpose. Every paid call is priced first, never paid for twice, measured after and written to a ledger, and a reserve stops a runaway loop. The key is never typed into the chat.
author: Itqan Lab

name: higgsfield-studio
description: Make images, video, audio, 3D, ads, product shoots, thumbnails, explainers and websites with Higgsfield from the agent, and spend the credits on purpose. Every paid job is priced first, never paid for twice, measured after and written to a ledger, and a reserve stops a runaway loop. Built on Higgsfield's official skills.
author: Itqan Lab

name: image-prompt
description: Write image prompts in the project's brand, sized for each platform, ready for any image generator. Reads the project's own brand file, logs every prompt so none is written twice, suggests a Higgsfield model and ratio, and never spends credits.
author: Itqan Lab

name: video-prompt
description: Write video prompts in the project's brand, sized and timed for each platform, ready for any video generator. Reads the project's own brand file, spells out the motion, logs every prompt so none is written twice, suggests a Higgsfield model, and never spends credits.
author: Itqan Lab

name: video-watch
description: Let the agent watch a video — any of 1750+ sites or a local file. Pulls captions or transcribes locally, extracts frames the agent can Read. Includes a setup wizard. No API key.
author: Itqan Lab

name: toolkit-credentials
description: Shared credential setup and storage for skills that need an API key or token. Guides any user through obtaining and storing a credential without it ever being typed into the conversation. macOS, Windows and Linux.
author: Itqan Lab

name: toolkit-updates
description: Check whether the toolkit skills installed on this machine are up to date, and see exactly what changed in each newer version before updating. Read-only, and works with every agent that reads skills.
author: Itqan Lab
